data.title: Trade and Explore Place Value
data.description: Learn how base-ten blocks can be traded between columns to understand place value.

challenges.instruction: Trade one of your tens for ones.
challenges.hint: Think about how many ones are in a single ten block before you make the trade.

challenges.instruction: Perform a trade with your current blocks.
challenges.hint: Break apart one larger block into ten smaller blocks.

challenges.instruction: Trade one block to change your collection.
challenges.hint: Choose a ten block to exchange for ten ones.

challenges.instruction: Make a trade with the blocks on your mat.
challenges.hint: Remember that one ten equals ten ones.
